To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the electrochemical activity GSH is formed at AuNP-GCE, which is dependent on the ratio of reagents and the time of modification of the GE surface.

the electrochemical activity and mechanism of glutathione oxidation on a graphite electrode modified by gold nanoparticles in solutions of supporting salts of 0.1 М NaOH and 0.1 “ phosphate buffer is studied by the cyclic voltammetry method.
The electrochemical activity and oxidation mechanism of GSH at the AuNP-GCE are studied in the reaction mixture of HAuCl 3 and sodium borohydride.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the electrochemical activity and electrochemical behavior of GSH at the surface of the graphite electrode modified with the gold nanoparticles.

the electrochemical activity and mechanism of electrochemical reaction of glutathione (a tripeptide containing the thiol group) on the surface of the graphite electrodes modified by gold nanoparticles (AuNPGCE).
the development of a method for the electrochemical determination of GSH in the presence of a large excess of other amino acids.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the GSH electrochemical oxidation at the surface of AuNPGCE is accompanied by a change in the number of electrons and the formation of the product with a molecular mass of 129 Da, which can be attributed to the oxidation product of GSH.
the AuNP-GCE has a good catalytic effect on the oxidation reaction of GSH, and the electrochemical activity is dependent on the concentration of GSH.
AuNPs are a good electrocatalyst for the oxidation of GSH, and AuNPGCE has a high electrochemical activity of glutahione.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the GSH can be used as an effective mediator for the detection of the H 2 O 2 in the presence of AuNPGCE in the solution of 0.1 М NaOH, 20 °С, pH 13,0.
AuNPs can be used for the electrochemical detection of GSH.
the electrochemical activity GSH at the surface of AuNPGCE is formed at the ratio of reagents used to the preparation sols of gold nanoparticles, as well as at the modification time of GE surface.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the electrochemical activity and the mechanism of electrochemical reactions of GSH on the modified surface of the graphite electrode with gold nanoparticles depend on the ratio of reagents and the time of surface modification of GE with Au nanoparticles.
the AuNP-GCE can be used as a new type of electrochemical biosensor for the determination of GSH.
the electrochemical activity and stability of GSH at the surface of AuNPs-GCE in 1M NaOH and 0.1M phosphate buffer (pB) (pH 7) is higher than at GE.
